Look your best
no matter the
occasion.
The 2023 Blazer is the SUV that’s well-built, roomy
and always in good taste. You’ll turn heads thanks
to its strong stance, updated grille and front
fascia, and five new wheel designs. Choose from
four models, including the well-equipped 2LT and
3LT, the sport-tuned RS and the sophisticated
Premier. Inside, a roomy, driver-centric interior
includes up to 64.2 cubic feet 1 of maximum cargo
space with the rear seats folded down. Even the
second-row seats recline, while sliding forward or
backward for more flexibility. Two engine choices
provide effortless performance: a turbocharged
2.0L engine or a 308-horsepower V6. Peace of
mind is added with standard Chevy Safety Assist,2
a package of six driver assistance features.
Blazer lets you be your best.
